items.t: Verizon Communications (VZ) Cuts 13,000 Jobs As Dan Schulman Pushes Turnaround
items.sum: Verizon Communications (NYSE:VZ) is undergoing a CEO-led overhaul under Dan Schulman, focused on stripping out entrenched bureaucracy. The turnaround plan includes approximately 13,000 job cuts as part of a broader restructuring of management layers and internal processes. Management is tying the cultural reset to early signs of improved customer performance and profitability across Verizon's core

items.t: Musk Says SpaceX “Could Just Acquire That Legacy Telco.” AT&T and Verizon Own What He Wants
items.sum: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said SpaceX “could just acquire” a legacy telco to use its spectrum, after Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile reportedly turned down SpaceX’s requests to run on their networks. Musk’s comment shows that the spectrum AT&T and Verizon own is the asset SpaceX wants.
